title: UK ICO AI Enforcement Action Trends — Q3 2026
hook: ICO enforcement notices Q3 2026 — three deployers cited for absent human review in automated recruitment
answer_first: The UK ICO issued enforcement notices to three recruitment platform deployers under Article 22 UK GDPR for failure to provide meaningful human review in AI-driven candidate screening. Updated profiling guidance confirms statistical models making consequential decisions fall within scope. The ICO AI Assurance programme now lists approved providers on its register.
council_positioning: Monitored containment, not provable isolation. Verified measurement credential. UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.
sources: ICO AI and Data Protection Guidance (updated Sept 2026)
